name: app-detect-bad-channels-eeg-v2
summary: Detects bad EEG channels in epoched data from baseline variance (MAD z-score, dead and flat channels) with MNE-Python and marks them in info['bads'] without interpolation.
description: Designed to run before ICA: variance is computed in the pre-stimulus window to avoid flagging channels with strong evoked responses. Channels are flagged if their MAD z-score exceeds z_thresh, their variance is under 1/100 of the median, or they are flat in over half of the epochs; extra channels can be added by name. Epochs are saved unchanged except for the bads list; interpolate after ICA.

outputs.description: The same epochs with detected bad channels listed in info['bads'].

parameters.description: MAD z-score threshold. Channels flagged if variance deviates more than this many robust SDs from median
Comma-separated channel names to mark bad in addition to those detected.
parameters.placeholder: Comma-separated channel names to force-mark bad (e.g. E1,E2)
